abilities.name: Overflowing Chaos
abilities.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability grants 1 Chaos. Chaos can stack up to 3 times. While Orphea has Chaos, her Basic Attacks against Heroes consume all Chaos, dealing 50% increased damage per stack, and healing for 100% of the damage dealt.; trait

fields.notes: Orpheas hands glow purplish-pink when she has Chaos stacks. Chaos stacks additively with itself and multiplicatively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Orphea's Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Shadow Waltz
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 165 damage to enemies in a line. Hitting a Hero with Shadow Waltz sets its cooldown to 2 seconds, refunds 35 Mana, and causes Orphea to dash a short distance upon moving.

fields.notes: Cannot be self-cast. Casting Shadow Waltz will drop all commands upon casting (except attack commands, if the target is still within Orphea's Attack Range). Upon hitting a Heroic Target Waltz Dash is enabled for 2 seconds. During this time the first movement command issued, including Ability and attack orders that require her to move in their range, causes Orphea to dash in that direction. Can be cast while Rooted, but Orphea cannot dash afterward if she was/became Rooted after hitting an enemy Hero. Orphea cannot attack while dashing.

abilities.name: Chomp
abilities.description: After 0.625 seconds, deal 305 damage to nearby enemies in front of Orphea.

fields.notes: 1) The accurate Area of Effect is done by a vertex. It's a mirrored area drawn by points (-3,0), (-3,-2), (-2.5,-3.5) (-1.5,-4.5) and (0,-5) in order. Casting Chomp will drop all movement commands, but not attack commands.

abilities.name: Dread
abilities.description: Release a wave of dread that deals 85 damage to enemies hit. Dread erupts 0.75 seconds after reaching the end of its path, dealing 175 damage. Enemies hit by Dread's wave or eruption are Slowed by 25% for 2 seconds.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Self-castable,, Slow
fields.notes: Damage from Dread is applied before the Slow. Enemies can be hit by path only once per cast.

abilities.name: Eternal Feast
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, deal 210 damage in an area. Eternal Feast repeats every 1 second as long as it hits an enemy Hero.; 50; 75; heroic

fields.notes: Drops all movement commands, but not attacks.

abilities.name: Crushing Jaws
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, pull enemies in an area toward the center, dealing 250 damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.; 70; 75; heroic

fields.notes: Damage from Crushing Jaws is applied before the Stun. Cannot be self-cast.

talents.name: En Pointe
talents.description: Shadow Waltz deals an increased 90% damage to enemies hit by its end and grants 1 additional Chaos.

fields.notes: Gaining additional Chaos also requires hitting Heroes with the end area. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Shadow Waltz 's damage.

_raw_fields: Shadow Waltz deals an increased 90% damage to enemies hit by its end and grants 1 additional Chaos.

talents.name: Growing Nightmare
talents.description: Increase Dread's damage by 50%. Quest Hit 3 Heroes with a single cast of Dread's eruption. Permanently increase Dread's eruption damage by 50% and increase the Slow amount of Dread's eruption by 15%.

fields.notes: Passive and quest bonus stack additively with each other as well as other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Dread 's damage.

_raw_fields: Increase Dread's damage by 50%. Quest Hit 3 Heroes with a single cast of Dread's eruption. Permanently increase Dread's eruption damage by 50% and increase the Slow amount of Dread's eruption by 15%.

talents.name: Ancestral Strength
talents.description: Non-Heroic Abilities deal 15% more damage to Stunned, Rooted, Silenced or Slowed enemies. Enemy Heroes who are hit with Overflowing Chaos are Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Slow is applied after damage is dealt. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting damage dealt by Orphea's Abilities.

_raw_fields: Non-Heroic Abilities deal 15% more damage to Stunned, Rooted, Silenced or Slowed enemies. Enemy Heroes who are hit with Overflowing Chaos are Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

talents.name: Allegrissimo
talents.description: Reduce the cooldown of Shadow Waltz by 1 second. Hitting Heroes with the end of Shadow Waltz sets its cooldown to 0.75 seconds.
_raw_fields: Reduce the cooldown of Shadow Waltz by 1 second. Hitting Heroes with the end of Shadow Waltz sets its cooldown to 0.75 seconds.

talents.name: Backbiter
talents.description: If Chomp hits a Hero, Orphea immediately dashes a short distance backwards. Passive Gain 15% maximum Health.

fields.notes: Removes existing displacement effects from Orphea upon triggering.

_raw_fields: If Chomp hits a Hero, Orphea immediately dashes a short distance backwards. Passive Gain 15% maximum Health.

talents.name: Chaotic Assault
talents.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes while having 3 stacks of Chaos deal an additional 75% bonus damage.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with Chaos stacks, and multiplicatively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Orphea's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes while having 3 stacks of Chaos deal an additional 75% bonus damage.

talents.name: Insatiable
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Chomp sets its cooldown to 2 seconds.
_raw_fields: Hitting a Hero with Chomp sets its cooldown to 2 seconds.

talents.name: Ravenous Hunger
talents.description: Questonly Minions that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Chomp permanently increase its damage by 2 and heal Orphea for 60. Heroes that die increase its damage by 40 and heal Orphea for 25% of her maximum Health.
_raw_fields: Questonly Minions that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Chomp permanently increase its damage by 2 and heal Orphea for 60. Heroes that die increase its damage by 40 and heal Orphea for 25% of her maximum Health.

talents.name: Mind Devourer
talents.description: Quest Hitting Heroes with Dread increases its damage by 5, up to 150. After hitting 30 Heroes, hitting an enemy Hero with Dread's eruption sets its cooldown to 6 seconds and refunds 50 Mana.
_raw_fields: Quest Hitting Heroes with Dread increases its damage by 5, up to 150. After hitting 30 Heroes, hitting an enemy Hero with Dread's eruption sets its cooldown to 6 seconds and refunds 50 Mana.

talents.name: Determination
talents.description: After dashing with Shadow Waltz, Orphea gains 50 Spell Armor, stacking up to 2 times. While Orphea has Determination, her Physical Damage is increased by 15%.

fields.type: Defensive damage modifier, Offensive damage modifier
fields.notes: Additional charges do not modify damage dealt. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that affect Orphea's Physical Damage output. Does not stack with other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: After dashing with Shadow Waltz, Orphea gains 50 Spell Armor, stacking up to 2 times. While Orphea has Determination, her Physical Damage is increased by 15%.

talents.name: Abyssal Symbiosis
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Chomp instantly grants Orphea maximum Chaos and a 170 Shield for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Shield does not stack with itself.

_raw_fields: Hitting a Hero with Chomp instantly grants Orphea maximum Chaos and a 170 Shield for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Invasive Miasma
talents.description: Cooldown 10 Active Activate to deal 150 damage to all nearby enemies after 2 seconds. For each Hero hit, heal for 182 and gain 1 Chaos.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 10 Active Activate to deal 150 damage to all nearby enemies after 2 seconds. For each Hero hit, heal for 182 and gain 1 Chaos.

talents.name: Bond of Anguish
talents.description: Shadow Waltz deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 3% of their maximum Health, healing Orphea for 50% of the damage dealt.
_raw_fields: Shadow Waltz deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 3% of their maximum Health, healing Orphea for 50% of the damage dealt.

talents.name: Dead Magic
talents.description: Basic Attacks that consume Chaos ignore Armor and deal 90 Spell Damage to the target and all enemies around them.

fields.notes: Armor piercing only affects the Basic Attack damage dealt to the primary target. Armor piercing ignores only positive Armor effects. Splash does not interact with Overflowing Chaos or the talents affecting it. It can still be affected by offensive Spell Damage modifiers, like Spell Power.

_raw_fields: Basic Attacks that consume Chaos ignore Armor and deal 90 Spell Damage to the target and all enemies around them.

talents.name: Lurking Terror
talents.description: Mana 60 Cooldown 10 Active After Dread erupts and for 2 seconds afterward, activate to cast Chomp from the eruption area. Enemy Heroes hit by this Chomp are Slowed by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Cooldown is shared with Chomp. Interacts with all Talents affecting Chomp, except Backbiter.

_raw_fields: Mana 60 Cooldown 10 Active After Dread erupts and for 2 seconds afterward, activate to cast Chomp from the eruption area. Enemy Heroes hit by this Chomp are Slowed by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

talents.name: Monster Within
talents.description: Eternal Feast grants 1 Chaos each time it hits a Hero. While Eternal Feast is active and for 5 seconds afterward, Orphea's Basic Abilities recharge 150% faster.
_raw_fields: Eternal Feast grants 1 Chaos each time it hits a Hero. While Eternal Feast is active and for 5 seconds afterward, Orphea's Basic Abilities recharge 150% faster.

talents.name: Engulfing Oblivion
talents.description: Crushing Jaws reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 50 for 3 seconds. Takedowns set its cooldown to 5 seconds.

fields.notes: Armor reduction is applied after damage is dealt. Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Crushing Jaws reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 50 for 3 seconds. Takedowns set its cooldown to 5 seconds.

talents.name: Eldritch Conduit
talents.description: Each Chaos consumed increases Orphea's Spell Power by 3%, up to 30%. After reaching the maximum bonus, the Spell Power is increased by an additional 30%. Lasts 10 seconds.

fields.notes: Each application refreshes the timer. Spell Power from Eldritch Conduit stacks additively with itself and other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting Orphea's Spell Damage or healing output.

_raw_fields: Each Chaos consumed increases Orphea's Spell Power by 3%, up to 30%. After reaching the maximum bonus, the Spell Power is increased by an additional 30%. Lasts 10 seconds.

talents.name: Final Toccata
talents.description: Cooldown 20 Active Activate to instantly reset the cooldown of Shadow Waltz. For the next 5 seconds, dashing with Shadow Waltz resets its cooldown and increases the duration of Final Toccata by 1 second.
